title: affected.py selects by diff when a new non-Python file is missing from the map
findings_note: s324 and s326 relays 2026-10-17: `affected.py --run` refused in fresh worktrees with "src/slicer/templates/relay-brief.md is not in the map", because the borrowed map predates s322's template
boundary: **Not in this slice:** the clean flag or map borrowing rules (s344, s355).

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: A map borrowed from another worktree is recorded at an older commit. A non-Python file added since then (s322's `relay-brief.md` template) is not in the map, and `affected.py --run` exits 2, so every relay after s322 ran the full discover instead of the affected tests. Each full run took 20 to 30 minutes under parallel load.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `tests/affected.py`: a changed file absent from the map selects the tests that read files under its directory (or its loader module), and says so on stderr, instead of refusing; refuse only when that is empty.
- `tests/test_affected.py`.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Write the tests; watch the first go red.
2. Add the fallback selection with a stderr line naming it.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: One commit on the slice branch; the owner lands it.
